content:
Example: What are the names of the first 5 customers?
SELECT customers.id AS iCustomerId, customers.company AS strCustomerName
FROM customers
ORDER BY customers.id ASC
LIMIT 5

Example: What are the name of customer with id 50?
SELECT customers.company AS strCustomerName
FROM customers
WHERE 
	customers.id = 50
ORDER BY customers.id ASC

Example: What are the name of country with id 1?
SELECT countries.country_name
FROM countries
WHERE
countries.country_id = 1

Example: What country is supplier with id 1 from?
SELECT countries.country_name
FROM suppliers
INNER JOIN countries ON countries.country_id = suppliers.country_id
WHERE id = 1

Example: Which brand has the most customers?
SELECT
	brands.dpId AS iBrandId,
	brands.dpName AS strBrandName,
	COUNT(DISTINCT customers_brands.cbCustomerId) AS iCustomerCount
FROM customers_brands
INNER JOIN brands ON brands.dpId = customers_brands.cbBrandId
GROUP BY brands.dpId, brands.dpName
ORDER BY iCustomerCount DESC
LIMIT 1

Example: Which salesperson has the most customers?
SELECT
	users.uId,
	users.uName AS strSalePersonName,
	COUNT(DISTINCT customers_brands.cbCustomerId)
FROM users
LEFT JOIN
customers_brands ON
customers_brands.cbSalespersonId =users.uId
INNER JOIN
customers ON
	customers.id = customers_brands.cbCustomerId
 && customers.disabled = 0
WHERE
	users.is_salesmen = 1
GROUP BY customers_brands.cbSalespersonId
ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT customers_brands.cbCustomerId) DESC

Example: When was the user with id 1 created?
SELECT users.added_date FROM users WHERE users.uid = 1

Example: When was the customer with id 1 created?
SELECT customers.added_date FROM customers WHERE customers.id = 1

Example: When was the brand with id 1 created?
SELECT brands.added_date FROM brands WHERE brands.dpId = 1

Example: What is the name of the brand with id 1 created?
SELECT brands.dpName FROM brands WHERE brands.dpId = 1

Example: Which brand has the most styles?
SELECT
	brands.dpId AS iBrandId,
	brands.dpName AS strBrandName,
	COUNT(DISTINCT styles.sId) AS iStyleCount
FROM styles
INNER JOIN brands ON brands.dpId = styles.sBrand
GROUP BY brands.dpId, brands.dpName
ORDER BY iStyleCount DESC
LIMIT 1

Example: What colors does style with giving style No have?
SELECT color_master.color_name
FROM color_master
		 INNER JOIN styles_colors ON
	styles_colors.color_master_id = color_master.color_master_id
		 INNER JOIN styles ON
	styles.sId = styles_colors.scStyleId
WHERE styles.sStyleNo = 'testNo'

Example: Get me ID from the customer with the name Spy?
SELECT customers.id FROM customers WHERE customers.company = 'Spy'

Example: Get me the name of the customer with the ID 1?
SELECT customers.company FROM customers WHERE customers.id = 1

Example: Get me the name of the customer with the ID 1?
SELECT customers.company AS strName FROM customers WHERE customers.id = 1

Example: Get me the name of the customer with the ID 1?
SELECT customers.company AS sName FROM customers WHERE customers.id = 1

Example: Find customer by name/company name
SELECT customers.id AS iCustomerId, customers.company AS strCustomerName
FROM customers
WHERE customers.company LIKE '%SEARCH_TERM%'
LIMIT 10

Example: Find orders for customer with company name containing CANSON or similar search term
SELECT 
	s_order_main.id AS iSOMainID,
	s_order_main.order_no AS iOrderNo,
	s_order_main.added_date AS dtAddedDate,
	s_order_main.status AS strOrderStatus,
	customers.id AS iCustomerId,
	customers.company AS strCustomerName
FROM s_order_main
INNER JOIN customers ON customers.id = s_order_main.customer_id
WHERE customers.company LIKE '%CANSON%'
ORDER BY s_order_main.added_date DESC
LIMIT 20

Example: Get customer ID from company name
SELECT customers.id AS iCustomerId, customers.company AS strCustomerName
FROM customers
WHERE customers.company LIKE '%COMPANY_NAME%'

Example: Find consignment orders for a specific customer by name
SELECT 
	s_order_main.id AS iSOMainID,
	s_order_main.order_no AS iOrderNo,
	s_order_main.added_date AS dtAddedDate,
	s_order_main.status AS strOrderStatus,
	customers.id AS iCustomerId,
	customers.company AS strCustomerName
FROM s_order_main
INNER JOIN customers ON customers.id = s_order_main.customer_id
WHERE customers.company LIKE '%CUSTOMER_SEARCH%'
	&& s_order_main.status = 'consignment'
ORDER BY s_order_main.added_date DESC

Example: Find all consignment orders
SELECT 
	s_order_main.id AS iSOMainID,
	s_order_main.order_no AS iOrderNo,
	s_order_main.status AS strOrderStatus,
	s_order_main.customer_id AS iCustomerID,
	customers.company AS strCustomerName,
	s_order_main.added_date AS dtAddedDate
FROM s_order_main
INNER JOIN customers ON customers.id = s_order_main.customer_id
WHERE s_order_main.status = 'consignment'
ORDER BY s_order_main.added_date DESC

Example: Get pending consignment entries for a specific order
SELECT 
	s_order_consignment_pending.id AS iPendingConsignmentID,
	s_order_consignment_pending.type AS strType,
	s_order_consignment_pending.s_order_main_id AS iSOMainID,
	s_order_consignment_pending.qty AS iQty,
	s_order_consignment_pending.sales_price AS fSalesPrice,
	s_order_consignment_pending.discount AS fDiscount,
	s_order_consignment_pending.store_cut AS fStoreCut,
	s_order_consignment_pending.date AS dtConsignmentDate,
	s_order_consignment_pending.added_date AS dtAddedDate
FROM s_order_consignment_pending
WHERE s_order_consignment_pending.s_order_main_id = 123
	&& s_order_consignment_pending.is_deleted = 0
ORDER BY s_order_consignment_pending.date DESC

Example: Sum pending consignment quantities by style variant
SELECT 
	s_order_consignment_pending.style_variant_id AS iStyleVariantID,
	styles.sStyleNo AS strStyleNo,
	SUM(s_order_consignment_pending.qty) AS iTotalQty,
	SUM(s_order_consignment_pending.qty * s_order_consignment_pending.sales_price) AS fTotalSalesValue
FROM s_order_consignment_pending
INNER JOIN styles_variants ON styles_variants.id = s_order_consignment_pending.style_variant_id
INNER JOIN styles ON styles.sId = styles_variants.style_id
WHERE s_order_consignment_pending.s_order_main_id = 123
	&& s_order_consignment_pending.is_deleted = 0
GROUP BY s_order_consignment_pending.style_variant_id, styles.sStyleNo
ORDER BY iTotalQty DESC

Example: Find consignment orders with pending entries count
SELECT 
	s_order_main.id AS iSOMainID,
	s_order_main.order_no AS iOrderNo,
	customers.company AS strCustomerName,
	COUNT(s_order_consignment_pending.id) AS iPendingCount,
	SUM(s_order_consignment_pending.qty) AS iTotalPendingQty
FROM s_order_main
INNER JOIN customers ON customers.id = s_order_main.customer_id
LEFT JOIN s_order_consignment_pending ON s_order_consignment_pending.s_order_main_id = s_order_main.id
	&& s_order_consignment_pending.is_deleted = 0
WHERE s_order_main.status = 'consignment'
GROUP BY s_order_main.id, s_order_main.order_no, customers.company
HAVING iPendingCount > 0
ORDER BY iPendingCount DESC

Example: Get consignment orders by customer with totals
SELECT 
	customers.id AS iCustomerID,
	customers.company AS strCustomerName,
	COUNT(DISTINCT s_order_main.id) AS iConsignmentOrderCount,
	SUM(s_order_consignment_pending.qty) AS iTotalPendingQty
FROM s_order_main
INNER JOIN customers ON customers.id = s_order_main.customer_id
LEFT JOIN s_order_consignment_pending ON s_order_consignment_pending.s_order_main_id = s_order_main.id
	&& s_order_consignment_pending.is_deleted = 0
WHERE s_order_main.status = 'consignment'
GROUP BY customers.id, customers.company
ORDER BY iConsignmentOrderCount DESC

Example: Find pending consignment entries by date range
SELECT 
	s_order_consignment_pending.id AS iPendingConsignmentID,
	s_order_consignment_pending.type AS strType,
	s_order_consignment_pending.qty AS iQty,
	s_order_consignment_pending.sales_price AS fSalesPrice,
	s_order_consignment_pending.date AS dtConsignmentDate,
	s_order_main.order_no AS iOrderNo,
	customers.company AS strCustomerName
FROM s_order_consignment_pending
INNER JOIN s_order_main ON s_order_main.id = s_order_consignment_pending.s_order_main_id
INNER JOIN customers ON customers.id = s_order_main.customer_id
WHERE s_order_consignment_pending.date >= '2024-01-01'
	&& s_order_consignment_pending.date <= '2024-12-31'
	&& s_order_consignment_pending.is_deleted = 0
ORDER BY s_order_consignment_pending.date DESC

Example: Calculate store cut amounts for pending consignments
SELECT 
	s_order_main.id AS iSOMainID,
	s_order_main.order_no AS iOrderNo,
	customers.company AS strCustomerName,
	SUM(s_order_consignment_pending.qty * s_order_consignment_pending.sales_price) AS fTotalSales,
	SUM(s_order_consignment_pending.qty * s_order_consignment_pending.sales_price * s_order_consignment_pending.store_cut / 100) AS fStoreCutAmount
FROM s_order_consignment_pending
INNER JOIN s_order_main ON s_order_main.id = s_order_consignment_pending.s_order_main_id
INNER JOIN customers ON customers.id = s_order_main.customer_id
WHERE s_order_consignment_pending.is_deleted = 0
	&& s_order_consignment_pending.calculation_type = 'store_cut'
GROUP BY s_order_main.id, s_order_main.order_no, customers.company
ORDER BY fStoreCutAmount DESC

Example: Find pending consignment sales reports vs corrections
SELECT 
	s_order_consignment_pending.type AS strType,
	COUNT(s_order_consignment_pending.id) AS iEntryCount,
	SUM(s_order_consignment_pending.qty) AS iTotalQty,
	SUM(s_order_consignment_pending.qty * s_order_consignment_pending.sales_price) AS fTotalValue
FROM s_order_consignment_pending
WHERE s_order_consignment_pending.s_order_main_id = 123
	&& s_order_consignment_pending.is_deleted = 0
GROUP BY s_order_consignment_pending.type

Example: Find unprocessed pending consignments (without related order)
SELECT 
	s_order_consignment_pending.id AS iPendingConsignmentID,
	s_order_consignment_pending.type AS strType,
	s_order_consignment_pending.qty AS iQty,
	s_order_consignment_pending.date AS dtConsignmentDate,
	s_order_main.order_no AS iOrderNo,
	customers.company AS strCustomerName
FROM s_order_consignment_pending
INNER JOIN s_order_main ON s_order_main.id = s_order_consignment_pending.s_order_main_id
INNER JOIN customers ON customers.id = s_order_main.customer_id
WHERE s_order_consignment_pending.related_s_order_main_id = 0
	&& s_order_consignment_pending.is_deleted = 0
ORDER BY s_order_consignment_pending.added_date DESC

Example: Get consignment order with style details
SELECT 
	s_order_main.id AS iSOMainID,
	s_order_main.order_no AS iOrderNo,
	s_order_styles.s_order_style_id AS iSOStyleID,
	styles.sStyleNo AS strStyleNo,
	styles.sStyleName AS strStyleName,
	s_order_styles.so_qty AS iQty,
	s_order_styles.sales_price AS fPrice
FROM s_order_main
INNER JOIN s_order_styles ON s_order_styles.s_order_main_id = s_order_main.id
INNER JOIN styles ON styles.sId = s_order_styles.style_id
WHERE s_order_main.status = 'consignment'
	&& s_order_main.id = 123
ORDER BY styles.sStyleNo

Example: Get sales order by order ID from s_order_main
SELECT 
	s_order_main.id AS iSOMainID,
	s_order_main.order_no AS iOrderNo,
	s_order_main.status AS strOrderStatus,
	s_order_main.order_type AS strOrderType,
	s_order_main.customer_id AS iCustomerID,
	s_order_main.brand_id AS iBrandID,
	s_order_main.added_date AS dtAddedDate
FROM s_order_main
WHERE s_order_main.id = 123

Example: Find all confirmed orders for a customer
SELECT 
	s_order_main.id AS iSOMainID,
	s_order_main.order_no AS iOrderNo,
	s_order_main.status AS strOrderStatus,
	s_order_main.confirmed_date AS dtConfirmedDate,
	customers.company AS strCustomerName
FROM s_order_main
INNER JOIN customers ON customers.id = s_order_main.customer_id
WHERE s_order_main.customer_id = 50
	&& s_order_main.status = 'order'
ORDER BY s_order_main.confirmed_date DESC

Example: Count orders per brand
SELECT 
	brands.dpId AS iBrandID,
	brands.dpName AS strBrandName,
	COUNT(s_order_main.id) AS iOrderCount
FROM s_order_main
INNER JOIN brands ON brands.dpId = s_order_main.brand_id
WHERE s_order_main.status = 'order'
GROUP BY brands.dpId, brands.dpName
ORDER BY iOrderCount DESC

Example: Find orders by order number
SELECT 
	s_order_main.id AS iSOMainID,
	s_order_main.order_no AS iOrderNo,
	s_order_main.status AS strOrderStatus,
	s_order_main.channel AS strChannel,
	s_order_main.customer_id AS iCustomerID,
	customers.company AS strCustomerName
FROM s_order_main
INNER JOIN customers ON customers.id = s_order_main.customer_id
WHERE s_order_main.order_no = 12345

Example: Get B2C orders (webshop orders) from s_order_main
SELECT 
	s_order_main.id AS iSOMainID,
	s_order_main.order_no AS iOrderNo,
	s_order_main.channel AS strChannel,
	s_order_main.customer_orderno AS strCustomerOrderNo,
	s_order_main.email AS strEmail,
	s_order_main.added_date AS dtAddedDate
FROM s_order_main
WHERE s_order_main.channel = 'b2c'
	&& s_order_main.status = 'order'
ORDER BY s_order_main.added_date DESC
LIMIT 20

Example: Find orders by salesperson
SELECT 
	s_order_main.id AS iSOMainID,
	s_order_main.order_no AS iOrderNo,
	s_order_main.status AS strOrderStatus,
	s_order_main.customer_id AS iCustomerID,
	customers.company AS strCustomerName,
	users.uName AS strSalespersonName
FROM s_order_main
INNER JOIN customers ON customers.id = s_order_main.customer_id
INNER JOIN users ON users.uId = s_order_main.salesmen_user_id
WHERE s_order_main.salesmen_user_id = 10
	&& s_order_main.status = 'order'
ORDER BY s_order_main.added_date DESC

Example: Get orders for a specific season
SELECT 
	s_order_main.id AS iSOMainID,
	s_order_main.order_no AS iOrderNo,
	s_order_main.order_type AS strOrderType,
	s_order_main.customer_id AS iCustomerID,
	customers.company AS strCustomerName,
	seasons.season_name AS strSeasonName
FROM s_order_main
INNER JOIN customers ON customers.id = s_order_main.customer_id
INNER JOIN seasons ON seasons.season_id = s_order_main.season_id
WHERE s_order_main.season_id = 5
	&& s_order_main.status = 'order'
ORDER BY s_order_main.order_no DESC

Example: Find orders with a specific import type (Shopify, EDI, etc.)
SELECT 
	s_order_main.id AS iSOMainID,
	s_order_main.order_no AS iOrderNo,
	s_order_main.import_type AS strImportType,
	s_order_main.customer_orderno AS strCustomerOrderNo,
	s_order_main.added_date AS dtAddedDate
FROM s_order_main
WHERE s_order_main.import_type = 'shopify'
	&& s_order_main.status = 'order'
ORDER BY s_order_main.added_date DESC
LIMIT 50

Example: Count orders by channel (normal, b2b, b2c)
SELECT 
	s_order_main.channel AS strChannel,
	COUNT(s_order_main.id) AS iOrderCount
FROM s_order_main
WHERE s_order_main.status = 'order'
GROUP BY s_order_main.channel
ORDER BY iOrderCount DESC

Example: Find orders confirmed in a specific date range
SELECT 
	s_order_main.id AS iSOMainID,
	s_order_main.order_no AS iOrderNo,
	s_order_main.confirmed_date AS dtConfirmedDate,
	s_order_main.customer_id AS iCustomerID,
	customers.company AS strCustomerName
FROM s_order_main
INNER JOIN customers ON customers.id = s_order_main.customer_id
WHERE s_order_main.status = 'order'
	&& s_order_main.confirmed_date >= '2024-01-01'
	&& s_order_main.confirmed_date <= '2024-12-31'
ORDER BY s_order_main.confirmed_date DESC

Example: Get order with delivery address details
SELECT 
	s_order_main.id AS iSOMainID,
	s_order_main.order_no AS iOrderNo,
	s_order_main.name AS strDeliveryName,
	s_order_main.company AS strDeliveryCompany,
	s_order_main.address AS strDeliveryAddress,
	s_order_main.address2 AS strDeliveryAddress2,
	s_order_main.postal_code AS strPostalCode,
	s_order_main.city AS strCity,
	countries.country_name AS strCountryName
FROM s_order_main
INNER JOIN countries ON countries.country_id = s_order_main.country_id
WHERE s_order_main.id = 123

Example: Find proposal orders (not yet confirmed)
SELECT 
	s_order_main.id AS iSOMainID,
	s_order_main.order_no AS iOrderNo,
	s_order_main.status AS strOrderStatus,
	s_order_main.added_date AS dtAddedDate,
	customers.company AS strCustomerName
FROM s_order_main
INNER JOIN customers ON customers.id = s_order_main.customer_id
WHERE s_order_main.status = 'proposal'
ORDER BY s_order_main.added_date DESC

Example: Get orders with payment term information
SELECT 
	s_order_main.id AS iSOMainID,
	s_order_main.order_no AS iOrderNo,
	s_order_main.payment_term_id AS iPaymentTermID,
	payment_term.ptPaymentName AS strPaymentTermName,
	customers.company AS strCustomerName
FROM s_order_main
INNER JOIN customers ON customers.id = s_order_main.customer_id
LEFT JOIN payment_term ON payment_term.ptId = s_order_main.payment_term_id
WHERE s_order_main.status = 'order'
ORDER BY s_order_main.order_no DESC
LIMIT 20

Example: Get all styles on a specific order
SELECT 
	s_order_styles.s_order_style_id AS iSOrderStyleID,
	s_order_styles.style_id AS iStyleID,
	styles.sStyleNo AS strStyleNo,
	styles.sStyleName AS strStyleName,
	s_order_styles.so_qty AS iOrderedQty,
	s_order_styles.so_delivered_qty AS iDeliveredQty,
	s_order_styles.sales_price AS fSalesPrice,
	s_order_styles.sales_discount_percentage AS fDiscountPct,
	s_order_styles.total_sales_price AS fTotalSalesPrice,
	s_order_styles.status AS strStatus
FROM s_order_styles
INNER JOIN styles ON styles.sId = s_order_styles.style_id
WHERE s_order_styles.s_order_main_id = 123
	&& s_order_styles.cancel = 0
ORDER BY styles.sStyleNo

Example: Find which orders contain a specific style
SELECT 
	s_order_main.id AS iSOMainID,
	s_order_main.order_no AS iOrderNo,
	s_order_main.status AS strOrderStatus,
	customers.company AS strCustomerName,
	s_order_styles.so_qty AS iOrderedQty,
	s_order_styles.sales_price AS fSalesPrice,
	s_order_main.added_date AS dtOrderDate
FROM s_order_styles
INNER JOIN s_order_main ON s_order_main.id = s_order_styles.s_order_main_id
INNER JOIN customers ON customers.id = s_order_main.customer_id
WHERE s_order_styles.style_id = 456
	&& s_order_styles.cancel = 0
	&& s_order_main.status = 'order'
ORDER BY s_order_main.added_date DESC

Example: Get total quantity sold per style
SELECT 
	s_order_styles.style_id AS iStyleID,
	styles.sStyleNo AS strStyleNo,
	styles.sStyleName AS strStyleName,
	SUM(s_order_styles.so_qty) AS iTotalOrderedQty,
	SUM(s_order_styles.so_delivered_qty) AS iTotalDeliveredQty,
	SUM(s_order_styles.total_sales_price) AS fTotalSalesValue
FROM s_order_styles
INNER JOIN styles ON styles.sId = s_order_styles.style_id
INNER JOIN s_order_main ON s_order_main.id = s_order_styles.s_order_main_id
WHERE s_order_styles.cancel = 0
	&& s_order_main.status = 'order'
GROUP BY s_order_styles.style_id, styles.sStyleNo, styles.sStyleName
ORDER BY iTotalOrderedQty DESC
LIMIT 20

Example: Find canceled style lines on orders
SELECT 
	s_order_styles.s_order_style_id AS iSOrderStyleID,
	s_order_main.order_no AS iOrderNo,
	styles.sStyleNo AS strStyleNo,
	s_order_styles.so_qty AS iCancelledQty,
	s_order_styles.cancel_comment AS strCancelComment,
	s_order_styles.cancel_date AS dtCancelDate,
	customers.company AS strCustomerName
FROM s_order_styles
INNER JOIN s_order_main ON s_order_main.id = s_order_styles.s_order_main_id
INNER JOIN styles ON styles.sId = s_order_styles.style_id
INNER JOIN customers ON customers.id = s_order_main.customer_id
WHERE s_order_styles.cancel = 1
ORDER BY s_order_styles.cancel_date DESC
LIMIT 50

Example: Get order lines with delivery status (ordered vs delivered)
SELECT 
	s_order_main.order_no AS iOrderNo,
	styles.sStyleNo AS strStyleNo,
	s_order_styles.so_qty AS iOrderedQty,
	s_order_styles.so_delivered_qty AS iDeliveredQty,
	(s_order_styles.so_qty - s_order_styles.so_delivered_qty) AS iRemainingQty,
	s_order_styles.status AS strStatus
FROM s_order_styles
INNER JOIN s_order_main ON s_order_main.id = s_order_styles.s_order_main_id
INNER JOIN styles ON styles.sId = s_order_styles.style_id
WHERE s_order_main.id = 123
	&& s_order_styles.cancel = 0
ORDER BY styles.sStyleNo

Example: Find orders with pending deliveries (not fully delivered)
SELECT 
	s_order_main.id AS iSOMainID,
	s_order_main.order_no AS iOrderNo,
	customers.company AS strCustomerName,
	SUM(s_order_styles.so_qty) AS iTotalOrderedQty,
	SUM(s_order_styles.so_delivered_qty) AS iTotalDeliveredQty,
	SUM(s_order_styles.so_qty - s_order_styles.so_delivered_qty) AS iPendingQty
FROM s_order_styles
INNER JOIN s_order_main ON s_order_main.id = s_order_styles.s_order_main_id
INNER JOIN customers ON customers.id = s_order_main.customer_id
WHERE s_order_styles.cancel = 0
	&& s_order_main.status = 'order'
GROUP BY s_order_main.id, s_order_main.order_no, customers.company
HAVING iPendingQty > 0
ORDER BY iPendingQty DESC

Example: Get sales by style and brand
SELECT 
	brands.dpId AS iBrandID,
	brands.dpName AS strBrandName,
	s_order_styles.style_id AS iStyleID,
	styles.sStyleNo AS strStyleNo,
	SUM(s_order_styles.so_qty) AS iTotalQty,
	SUM(s_order_styles.total_sales_price) AS fTotalSales
FROM s_order_styles
INNER JOIN styles ON styles.sId = s_order_styles.style_id
INNER JOIN brands ON brands.dpId = s_order_styles.brand_id
INNER JOIN s_order_main ON s_order_main.id = s_order_styles.s_order_main_id
WHERE s_order_styles.cancel = 0
	&& s_order_main.status = 'order'
GROUP BY brands.dpId, brands.dpName, s_order_styles.style_id, styles.sStyleNo
ORDER BY fTotalSales DESC
LIMIT 20

Example: Find styles with discount on orders
SELECT 
	s_order_main.order_no AS iOrderNo,
	styles.sStyleNo AS strStyleNo,
	s_order_styles.sales_price_original AS fOriginalPrice,
	s_order_styles.sales_price AS fActualPrice,
	s_order_styles.sales_discount_percentage AS fDiscountPct,
	s_order_styles.sales_price_discount_amt AS fDiscountAmount,
	s_order_styles.so_qty AS iQty
FROM s_order_styles
INNER JOIN s_order_main ON s_order_main.id = s_order_styles.s_order_main_id
INNER JOIN styles ON styles.sId = s_order_styles.style_id
WHERE s_order_styles.sales_discount_percentage > 0
	&& s_order_styles.cancel = 0
	&& s_order_main.status = 'order'
ORDER BY s_order_styles.sales_discount_percentage DESC
LIMIT 50

Example: Get order styles by salesperson
SELECT 
	users.uId AS iUserID,
	users.uName AS strSalespersonName,
	COUNT(DISTINCT s_order_styles.s_order_main_id) AS iOrderCount,
	COUNT(s_order_styles.s_order_style_id) AS iStyleLineCount,
	SUM(s_order_styles.so_qty) AS iTotalQty,
	SUM(s_order_styles.total_sales_price) AS fTotalSales
FROM s_order_styles
INNER JOIN users ON users.uId = s_order_styles.salesmen_user_id
INNER JOIN s_order_main ON s_order_main.id = s_order_styles.s_order_main_id
WHERE s_order_styles.cancel = 0
	&& s_order_main.status = 'order'

Example: Find orders where all styles are cancelled (completely cancelled orders)
SELECT
	s_order_main.id AS iSOrderID,
	s_order_main.order_no AS strOrderNo,
	s_order_main.status AS strStatus,
	customers.company AS strCustomerName,
	s_order_main.added_date AS dtAddedDate
FROM s_order_main
INNER JOIN customers ON customers.id = s_order_main.customer_id
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
	SELECT 1
	FROM s_order_styles
	WHERE s_order_styles.s_order_main_id = s_order_main.id

)

	SELECT 1
	FROM s_order_styles
	WHERE s_order_styles.s_order_main_id = s_order_main.id
)
ORDER BY s_order_main.added_date DESC

Example: Get colors for a style - IMPORTANT: color is NOT in styles table, must join via styles_colors to color_master
SELECT
	styles.sId AS iStyleID,
	styles.sStyleNo AS strStyleNo,
	styles.sStyleName AS strStyleName,
	styles_colors.scId AS iStyleColorID,
	color_master.color_master_id AS iColorMasterID,
	color_master.color_name AS strColorName
FROM styles
INNER JOIN styles_colors ON
	styles_colors.scStyleId = styles.sId
INNER JOIN color_master ON
	color_master.color_master_id = styles_colors.color_master_id
WHERE
	styles.sStyleNo = 'STYLE123'
ORDER BY
	color_master.color_name ASC

Example: Get all active colors for a brand
SELECT DISTINCT
	color_master.color_master_id AS iColorMasterID,
	color_master.color_name AS strColorName
FROM color_master
INNER JOIN styles_colors ON
	styles_colors.color_master_id = color_master.color_master_id
 && styles_colors.scInactive = 0
INNER JOIN styles ON
	styles.sId = styles_colors.scStyleId
 && styles.sCancel = 0
WHERE
	styles.sBrand = 1
 && color_master.inactive = 0
ORDER BY
	color_master.color_name ASC

Example: Search styles by color name
SELECT
	styles.sId AS iStyleID,
	styles.sStyleNo AS strStyleNo,
	styles.sStyleName AS strStyleName,
	color_master.color_name AS strColorName
FROM styles
INNER JOIN styles_colors ON
	styles_colors.scStyleId = styles.sId
 && styles_colors.scInactive = 0
INNER JOIN color_master ON
	color_master.color_master_id = styles_colors.color_master_id
WHERE
	color_master.color_name LIKE '%Black%'
 && styles.sCancel = 0
ORDER BY
	styles.sStyleNo ASC

Example: Get all colors for a style by style number

	styles.sId AS iStyleID,
	styles.sStyleNo AS strStyleNo,
	styles.sStyleName AS strStyleName,
	styles_colors.scId AS iStyleColorID,

Example: Retrieves all order lines for a sales order, including style number, style name, color, size, ordered quantity, and delivered quantity.
SELECT s_order_main.order_no                   AS iOrderNo,
	   styles.sStyleNo                         AS strStyleNo,
	   styles.sStyleName                       AS strStyleName,
	   color_master.color_name                 AS strColorName,
	   sizesets_sizes.szsName                  AS strSizeName,
	   s_order_style_sizesets.so_qty           AS iOrderedQty,
	   s_order_style_sizesets.so_delivered_qty AS iDeliveredQty
FROM s_order_main
		 INNER JOIN s_order_styles ON s_order_styles.s_order_main_id = s_order_main.id
		 INNER JOIN styles ON styles.sId = s_order_styles.style_id
		 INNER JOIN s_order_style_seasons ON s_order_style_seasons.s_order_style_id = s_order_styles.s_order_style_id
		 INNER JOIN s_order_style_colors ON s_order_style_colors.s_order_style_season_id = s_order_style_seasons.id
		 INNER JOIN styles_colors ON styles_colors.scId = s_order_style_colors.style_color_id
		 INNER JOIN color_master ON color_master.color_master_id = styles_colors.color_master_id
		 INNER JOIN s_order_style_sizesets ON s_order_style_sizesets.s_color_id = s_order_style_colors.s_color_id
		 INNER JOIN sizesets_sizes ON sizesets_sizes.szsId = s_order_style_sizesets.ss_sizeid
WHERE s_order_main.order_no = 6972
  AND s_order_styles.cancel = 0
ORDER BY styles.sStyleNo, color_master.color_name, sizesets_sizes.szsName

Example: Get sales order details with style and color information
SELECT
	s_order_main.order_no AS iOrderNo,
	s_order_main.id AS iSOMainID,
	styles.sStyleNo AS strStyleNo,
	styles.sStyleName AS strStyleName,
	color_master.color_name AS strColorName,
	s_order_styles.so_qty AS iOrderedQty,
	s_order_styles.so_delivered_qty AS iDeliveredQty
FROM s_order_main
INNER JOIN s_order_styles ON
	s_order_styles.s_order_main_id = s_order_main.id
INNER JOIN styles ON
	styles.sId = s_order_styles.style_id
INNER JOIN s_order_style_seasons ON
	s_order_style_seasons.s_order_style_id = s_order_styles.s_order_style_id
INNER JOIN s_order_style_colors ON
	s_order_style_colors.s_order_style_season_id = s_order_style_seasons.id
INNER JOIN styles_colors ON
	styles_colors.scId = s_order_style_colors.style_color_id
INNER JOIN color_master ON
	color_master.color_master_id = styles_colors.color_master_id
WHERE
	s_order_main.order_no = :iOrderNo

	styles.sStyleNo ASC,

Example: Getting sales order color and sizeset details
SELECT
	s_order_style_colors.s_color_id				AS iSOStyleColorID,
	s_order_style_colors.delivery_id			AS iDeliveryID,
	s_order_style_sizesets.s_style_sizeset_id	AS iSOStyleColorSizeID,
	s_order_style_sizesets.assortment_no		AS iAssortmentID,
	s_order_style_sizesets.ss_sizeid			AS iSizeMasterID,
	(
		s_order_style_sizesets.so_qty
	  -	s_order_style_sizesets.so_delivered_qty
	)											AS iRunningQty
FROM
	s_order_style_colors
INNER JOIN
	s_order_style_sizesets ON
		s_order_style_sizesets.s_color_id		= s_order_style_colors.s_color_id
WHERE
	s_order_style_colors.s_color_id				= '25'
ORDER BY
	s_order_style_colors.s_color_id ASC,
	s_order_style_colors.delivery_id ASC,
	s_order_style_sizesets.s_style_sizeset_id ASC
